correctness.rationale: For compact invariant measure, invariance of antiderivatives of arbitrary continuous one-coordinate test functions forces E[yz|x]=μx, E[x(z−a)|y]=μy, E[xy|z]=1. Conditional orthogonality gives all three exact variance defects and Cov(z,xy)=0. If E[dot z²]=0, support trajectories satisfy z=c,xy=1; recurrent points follow dot x=−μx+c/x and are equilibria. Full-measure recurrence plus closed equilibrium set gives support in E± for μ>0,a≥0, and conversely. Outside equilibrium mixtures both z and xy have positive variance; periodic xy−1 takes both signs and crosses twice.
